turns.text_snippet: I'll investigate how the Cronos development space handles git and compare it to what's needed for Delivery Notes.
Let me look at the Delivery Notes space configuration and how git is set up there.
Now I have the full picture. Let me also check how the space settings work for re-linking.

Now I have a complete understanding. Let me summarize the findings and apply the fix.

**Root Cause Analysis:**

| | Cronos Development | Delivery Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `space.yml` git_repo_url | `https://github.com/cilaman/cronos` | `https://github.com/cilaman/delivery-notes` |
| Actual git remote | `https://REDACTED@github.com/cilaman/cronos.git` | **`git@github.com:cilaman/delivery-notes.git` (SSH!)** |

The delivery-notes space was cloned at some point with or had its remote changed to an SSH URL, but the container has no SSH keys. Meanwhile `git_ops.py`'s `_auth_env()` (line 103) only injects the `CRONOS_GIT_TOKEN` for HTTPS URLs:

```python
if not token or not repo_url.startswith(("https://", "http://")):
    return None
```

So `push_branch()` and `fetch_origin()` get `env=None` for SSH URLs — no credentials, push fails.

**The fix** is to switch the delivery-notes remote from SSH to HTTPS, which lets `_auth_env()` inject the token. I'll also align it with the space.yml URL.
Remote is now HTTPS. Let me verify the `CRONOS_GIT_TOKEN` will work for the delivery-notes repo:

Fetch works (delivery-notes is a public repo, so reads don't need auth). Now for push, `git_ops.py`'s `push_branch()` will now call `_auth_env("https://github.com/cilaman/delivery-notes.git")` which will inject the `CRONOS_GIT_TOKEN` via `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=Authorization: Basic <base64(x-access-token:TOKEN)>` — exactly like Cronos development.

The fix is done. Here's the full diagnosis:

---

**How Cronos development differs from Delivery Notes (git)**

| | Cronos development | Delivery Notes (before fix) |
|---|---|---|
| git remote protocol | HTTPS | **SSH** |
| Remote URL | `https://REDACTED@github.com/cilaman/cronos.git` | `git@github.com:cilaman/delivery-notes.git` |
| SSH keys in container | Not needed | Not configured |
| `_auth_env()` injects token | Yes (HTTPS matches) | **No** (SSH → returns `None`) |
| Push result | Success | **Fails — no credentials** |

**Why**: `git_ops.py`'s `_auth_env()` only injects `CRONOS_GIT_TOKEN` for HTTPS URLs. The delivery-notes remote was SSH (likely changed manually at some point), but the container has no SSH keys.

**Fix applied**: Changed delivery-notes git remote from `git@github.com:cilaman/delivery-notes.git` to `https://github.com/cilaman/delivery-notes.git`. Now `push_branch()` and `fetch_origin()` will inject the `CRONOS_GIT_TOKEN` via HTTP Authorization header, matching how Cronos development works.

No code changes needed — the `git_ops.py` auth mechanism already handles HTTPS correctly.
